reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Password Reset Process
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Use the approved password reset portal, create a compliant password, and sign in again after the reset completes.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Re-register MFA
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: If MFA approvals or codes fail, remove the old authenticator registration and complete the organization's approved MFA registration process again.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Clear Print Queue
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Clear Print Queue
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again. This is a near-duplicate article retained for evaluation of duplicate knowledge.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: RDP Credential Repair
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Remove saved Remote Desktop credentials and reconnect using the current organization account.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Approved Software Installation
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Download the installer only from the approved internal source and install it with authorized administrator permission.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Re-create VPN Profile
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Remove the damaged VPN connection profile and create a new profile using the approved organization settings.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Re-create VPN Profile
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Remove the damaged VPN connection profile and create a new profile using the approved organization settings. This older article was written for Windows 10 and should be reviewed for newer systems.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: DNS Cache Recovery
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Renew Windows IP Address
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: For Wi-Fi connected with no internet, run ipconfig /release followed by ipconfig /renew, then reconnect to the wireless network.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Restart Network Adapter
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Disable and re-enable the Wi-Fi network adapter, then reconnect to the approved wireless network.

reviewed_approved_KB_families.title: Update Device Drivers
reviewed_approved_KB_families.body: Install manufacturer-approved device drivers through the approved update channel and restart the computer.
